One isolated icon on genuinely transparent alpha. No text, badge, background, ground shadow, additional objects or scene. Keep the original object footprint on a square 1280x1280 canvas.

No heart, badge, emblem, symbol or decoration anywhere on the box front. Preserve the entire rest exactly: red box, ivory lid, champagne bow, burgundy outlines, position, proportions, lighting, size and transparent background. Output a single transparent PNG icon, with no background and no text.
